svg.title: Temporal Understanding — The Knockout
svg.desc: What is the first thing Lao Mo does immediately after finishing his prayer? A. Tidies the shrine B. Takes off his apron C. Blows out the incense D. Softly calls out to Yaoyao E. Picks up the black cloth bag F. Puts on his coat Answer: D.

g.aria-label: What is the first thing Lao Mo does immediately after finishing his prayer?
What is the first thing Lao Mo does immediately after finishing his prayer?
Picks up the black cloth bag
